items.title: Ran Blake interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 16, 2021
items.q: I know ... Christine Correa, who’ve performed with me

ctx.x: Well if you did “A Hard Day’s Night” one day for an event and then the next day you did it again, would it be appreciably different?

Well we’d have to ask you if you were in the audience if you could stand my solo Third Stream Noir. I’m not — I do listen to myself subconsciously but again my, I can’t really say I have plots for the Beatles pieces. I’ve also tried “Yesterday” and I like the piece “Julia” very much, which I did when visiting Maryland. But I know Jeanne and a wonderful singers like Dominique Eade, Christine Correa, who’ve performed with me, Sara Serpa, they don’t seem to complain, and I think Houston Person who I adore might have…
Well I wonder if you’ve seen, it was about that time that you were working with Jeanne Lee and a film from 1963 and you two are on stage and you get introduced in French.
